name: Creamy Tossed Shrimp Lasagna Bake with Zucchini Ribbons & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 no-boil lasagna noodles
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the noodles are cooking, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini; run a peeler along the zucchini to make long, noodle-like strips. Place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, shrimp, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the veggies are done, add lasagna noodles, half of the basil, and cream to the skillet; toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Transfer veggie-shrimp mixture to a large baking dish. Top lasagna bake with mozzarella.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna bake between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
